context.context: On May 6, 2016, a gunman opened fire at the Westfield Montgomery Mall in Bethesda, Maryland, injuring three people, one of whom later died from their injuries. The scene depicted in the image captures the immediate aftermath of the shooting as emergency services converge on the location to provide assistance and secure the area. The incident was part of a series of violent events connected to Eulalio Tordil, a Federal Protective Service officer, who was subsequently arrested for the shootings, including the earlier killing of his estranged wife. The mall was placed on lockdown, and police undertook a significant operation to manage the emergency and investigate the shootings.
